definitions.explanation: A person employed to protect buildings, events, or people.

examples.japanese: {警備員|けいびいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入口|いりぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A security guard is standing at the entrance.

examples.japanese: {警備員|けいびいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{身分証|みぶんしょう}→身分証：11508_mibunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: I showed my ID to the security guard.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{警備員|けいびいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work as a security guard at a building.

notes:
{警備員|けいびいん} refers to security guards.
